label: Fleet Arrival
description: Capital ships making atmospheric entry over an open-sky world — scale sold from the ground up, with day-raid and night-siege variants.
prefix: The one-sheet frame of a capital fleet making atmospheric entry — tonnage the sky was never meant to carry, arriving anyway. Witnessed from the ground, production design coherent from rivet to skyline, an image read twice: first the scale, then the detail.
suffix: Scale Rendering: (planetary-scale mass made legible — hull lengths measured in city blocks, running lights in ordered rows, tiny craft and ground figures for reference:1.25), the fleet's shadow crossing the land like weather, atmospheric perspective staging each hull a step paler than the last, filmic tonemapping with disciplined highlights.
negative: watermark, text, toy-like scale, miniature model look, blurry, low detail
